Introduction
This procedure details the steps required to completely
 check the proper operation and calibration of the transformer protection,
 Differential Relay types D202 & D203 relay. It is recommended this
 procedure be carried out on a yearly bases. This work be carried out section
 of this document is divided into 3 sections.
The first preliminary steps to prepare for relay testing
 describes the activities required prior to testing. Some of these steps could
 be performed days before the actual test. The second section Preparation for
 testing describes the steps to set up the equipment for performing the actual
 tests. The third section is the actual test.
The document is formatted the way to minimize the
 possibility of error causing personal injury or damage to equipment.
D202
Designed for two-winding transformer and unit connection
transformers and generators. Inter-turn faults in the transformer winding are
also detected to avoid unselective tripping when the transformer is switched on,
the relay is made inrush-proof.
D202 + D203
For use with three winding power transformers, ancillary D203
contains the parts required for the third winding in addition to the
differential relay.
It has three CT's the necessary rectifier and a tripping
contactor.
Safety Precautions
Wear safety and healthy equipments as safety 
 helmet, safety shoes ..etc
Power transformer 
 must be isolated.
Make sure that CT Secondary circuits are shorted before isolating the
 current circuit for test current injection.
Tools and Equipment
Two current source, 
 2 Multi-meter
2 Variable resistor (0-100 ohm) 200 W
2 switch S1, S2, 
 Diode (Rectifier)
Work to be Carried Out
PICK UP TEST
Connect the Secondary injection test set to the relay as shown in figure
 (1)
Increase the injected current slowly until the relay operates.
Record the operating (differential) current.
Check the relay trips contacts are closed when the relay picks up, and
 these contacts open as the current is reduced.
Switch off the secondary injection test set.
Press the reset button on the relay in front panel and check that the flag
 reset.
Inject the current until the relay operates and switch of the test set.
Connect the timed contact of the relay to the stop time terminals of
 the secondary injection test set as shown in figure (2)
Switch on the current suddenly and record the operate time.
